# Gemini Intelligence's November 10 update: Pixel 10 gets new features via Pixel Drop, motorola signature 27 is a November 19 U.S. preorder, and widgets and Android Auto are still coming


By OpenTools Team


·


November 11, 2026


Google's November 10 Android announcement says Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro XL and Pixel 10 Pro Fold get the latest Gemini Intelligence features through that day's Pixel Drop. Motorola's first Gemini Intelligence phone, the motorola signature 27, is available for U.S. preorder on November 19, which is not a shipping date. Rambler is described as available on named Pixel 10 models and the Motorola phone, and task automation is expanding to the UK, India and Japan. Create My Widget, its Pixel Watch version and proactive Android Auto suggestions are still upcoming. Country, language, age, app, setup, Android version and usage conditions apply feature by feature, and some wording in the source is ambiguous.


##


The short answer


Google's November 10 post describes a staggered expansion, not one launch. Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro XL and Pixel 10 Pro Fold get the latest Gemini Intelligence features through that day's Pixel Drop. The motorola signature 27, Motorola's first Gemini Intelligence device, is available for U.S. preorder on November 19. A preorder is not a shipping date, and the post gives none. Create My Widget is rolling out over the next few weeks, its Pixel Watch version is coming in the next few weeks, and proactive suggestions in Android Auto are coming soon. Google also says feature availability varies by device.[1](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/gemini-intelligence-november-features-devices/)


##


Status by device


This is the device-by-feature picture the announcement supports. It does not cover every phone, and a blank means the post says nothing.


- **Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro XL, Pixel 10 Pro Fold:** named as getting the latest Gemini Intelligence features with the Pixel Drop. Rambler is also described as now available on these.
- **Pixel 10 Pro:** not named in the Pixel Drop sentence. The Rambler sentence appears to list it, but that list is garbled in the retained text, with "Pixel 10" repeated and "Pro XL" split off. Treat Pixel 10 Pro as unconfirmed for the broader Pixel Drop features, and check your own phone.
- **motorola signature 27:** U.S. preorder on November 19. Google's wording says Rambler is "now available" on it, but the post doesn't say when buyers can actually use it, and no shipping date, price or non-U.S. availability is given.
- **Pixel phones with Gemini Intelligence (no model list):** Android Auto proactive suggestions are coming "soon". The Pixel Watch version of Create My Widget is coming in the next few weeks.
- **Earlier devices:** Google says rollout began this summer on the Pixel 11 and on Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Z Fold8, Z Flip8 and S26 series. A footnote says the S26 series includes the S26, S26+ and S26 Ultra. Googlebook launched last month as the first laptop designed for Gemini Intelligence. The post doesn't say which of the new features reach these devices, only that availability varies by device.


[1](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/gemini-intelligence-november-features-devices/)


##


Status by feature


- **Rambler** turns spoken thoughts into organized text in real time. It is a Gboard capability for select countries and languages, subject to usage limits. Google says it is available now on the named Pixel 10 models and the new Motorola phone, with the Motorola caveat above.
- **Task automation** lets Gemini handle logistics such as ordering food, hailing rides or booking reservations across apps. It is expanding to the UK, India and Japan. It runs in the Gemini app for select countries and languages, for users 18+, and higher usage may require a subscription. The post doesn't say where it is already available, so "expanding" shouldn't be read as a list of current regions.
- **Create My Widget** builds a personalized widget from a plain-language description and can pull from Gmail, Calendar and Search. It is rolling out over the next few weeks, for select countries and languages, users 18+, with possible subscription needs for higher usage.
- **Create My Widget on Pixel Watch** is coming in the next few weeks. The post gives no separate conditions for it.
- **Device Assistance** lets you ask the phone to clear space, check which apps can access location, or mute distractions while letting important calls through. It is available on select Android devices running Android 17 or later, and capabilities may vary by device, language and country. The post gives no device list or date.
- **Proactive suggestions in Android Auto** are coming soon for Pixel phones with Gemini Intelligence. They require the Gemini app and setup, and are for select countries and languages and users 18+.


##


Conditions that cut across features


Google's footnotes attach different conditions to different features:


- **Country and language:** Rambler, task automation, Create My Widget and Android Auto suggestions carry "select countries and languages" footnotes, as does Gemini Intelligence in general. Device Assistance instead says availability and capabilities may vary by device, language and country. The Pixel Watch version of Create My Widget has no stated condition. The post names specific countries only for task automation: the UK, India and Japan.
- **Age:** task automation, Create My Widget and Android Auto suggestions are for users 18+. Google also says some Gemini Intelligence features are 18+ in general. The Rambler and Device Assistance footnotes don't state an age condition.
- **Subscription:** for task automation and Create My Widget, and more generally for some Gemini Intelligence features, a subscription may be required for higher usage. The post gives no price or usage thresholds.
- **Software and setup:** Device Assistance needs Android 17 or later on a select device. Android Auto suggestions need the Gemini app and setup. Rambler lives in Gboard, and task automation is described as available in the Gemini app.


##


A checking sequence by goal


The order depends on what you want.


1. **If you own a Pixel 10, Pro XL or Pro Fold:** look for the November Pixel Drop. For Rambler, confirm Gboard is your keyboard and that your language is supported. If you have a Pixel 10 Pro, check the feature on your phone rather than relying on the post's Rambler list.
2. **If you want Device Assistance:** check the Android version first. The post requires Android 17 or later on a select device.
3. **If you want task automation or Create My Widget:** check your account's age eligibility, your country and language, and whether the feature has appeared yet. Create My Widget is explicitly staged over the next few weeks, and heavy use may be subscription-limited.
4. **If you want Android Auto suggestions:** you need a Pixel phone with Gemini Intelligence, the Gemini app and setup. Google says only "soon".
5. **If you're considering the motorola signature 27:** the only date is November 19 for U.S. preorders. Confirm shipping, price and region with Motorola before relying on any feature.


This is a reading of Google's announcement, not a hands-on test of any device or account.


##


What the post does not settle


This is a single issuer source, so every availability statement is Google's claim and was not tested here. Open questions include:


- whether Pixel 10 Pro gets the full Pixel Drop feature set
- when the motorola signature 27 reaches buyers, and in which countries
- exact dates for Create My Widget on phones and watches, and for Android Auto suggestions
- the full country and language lists
- which devices count as "select" for Device Assistance
- subscription prices and usage thresholds


The post's own conditions, per device, region, language, age and setup, are the practical limits. Treat this as a staged rollout rather than a single launch.[1](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/gemini-intelligence-november-features-devices/)
